slots.hypothesis: The core is the nominal share price level, which the ablations show is the alpha source for 4 of the 5 heads. The low-price premium survives the linear LogFloatCap neutralization. The new periphery is a lottery-demand screen (Kumar 2009, Birru & Wang 2016, Bali et al. 2011, Amaya et al. 2015): within the cheap segment, drop the high realized-skewness, right-tail and vol-scaled-MAX names. It is built from operators not seen in the snapshot: cs_last_high20/10 exclusion screens, cs_bucket_rank/zscore conditional sorts within price deciles, rank interactions, and a second screen that removes the cheapest 5-10%. 13 seeds.

Overnight-gap sentiment reversal (Berkman et al. 2012, Aboody et al. 2018, Lou-Polk-Skouras 2019). Retail buying in the opening call auction, combined with T+1, puts a sentiment premium into the open price that later reverses. The long book buys stocks with persistently low cumulative overnight returns, ON = log(day_first(Open) / previous day_last(Close)). Seeds use mean/sum/median/decay, scale-free t-stat and gap-up frequency versions, auction-volume weighting, and abnormal-versus-own-baseline forms. Intraday returns are avoided to stay clear of the 20-day reversal control. Inspired by the opening-session volume signal in head +0.58. 12 seeds.
